headline: Executive order creates a new White House council focused on US energy policy.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group in the federal government called the National Energy Dominance Council. Based on its title, the council is meant to coordinate federal work on energy. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council and what powers it has are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: These agencies may work with or report to the new council on energy matters.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 14, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
